# How are tissues grouped in a plant?

<!-- STEP id="together" -->
## Tissues work together
So far, you have met tissues for protection, support and conduction. In a plant body, these tissues do not work alone. They are grouped into larger units called tissue systems.

<!-- STEP id="dermal" -->
## Dermal tissue system
The dermal tissue system forms the outer covering of the plant. It protects the inner parts and reduces water loss.

<!-- STEP id="ground" -->
## Ground tissue system
The ground tissue system forms the main body of the plant, between the dermal tissue and the conducting tissues. It includes parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma.

<!-- STEP id="vascular" -->
## Vascular tissue system
The vascular tissue system is made of the conducting tissues, xylem and phloem.

**A leaf, a stem and a root each have all three tissue systems.**
